rationale: C10 plausibly supplied a concrete and material drafting template. Both orders establish a specialized Federal council, specify its membership and a President-designated chairman, assign advisory and interagency-coordination functions, and then use nearly identical administrative machinery for agency assistance, employee details, and information requests. The close wording and parallel organization—especially in the establishment and agency-assistance provisions—substantially exceed generic council boilerplate. C01 and C05 contain related section-214 assistance language, but neither matches the child's overall council structure and subject-matter setting as closely as C10.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There is hereby established the Federal Radiation Council (hereinafter referred to as the "Council").
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There is hereby established the Federal Council for Science and Technology (hereinafter referred to as the Council).
shared_material.explanation: Distinctively parallel establishment and defined-name language for a specialized Federal council.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Chairman of the Council shall be designated by the President, from time to time, from among the members of the Council.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Chairman of the Council ... shall be designated by the President from time to time from among the members thereof.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Council shall advise the President with respect to radiation matters directly or indirectly affecting health... The Council shall take steps designed to further the interagency coordination of measures...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Council shall consider problems and developments in the fields of science and technology and related activities affecting more than one Federal agency... and shall recommend policies and other measures...
shared_material.explanation: Parallel substantive role: advise on a technical field spanning agencies and promote coordinated Federal action.

shared_material.child_excerpt: For the purpose of effectuating this order, each executive agency represented on the Council shall furnish necessary assistance to the Council, in consonance with section 214 of the act of May 3, 1945... Such assistance may include detailing employees to the Council to perform such duties consistent with the purposes of this order as the Chairman of the Council may assign to them.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: For the purpose of effectuating this order, each Federal agency represented on the Council shall furnish necessary assistance to the Council in consonance with section 214 of the act of May 3, 1945... Such assistance may include (1) detailing employees to the Council to perform such functions, consistent with the purposes of this order, as the Chairman may assign to them...
shared_material.explanation: This is nearly verbatim legal and administrative machinery, adapted only in minor wording.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Upon the request of the Chairman of the Council, the heads of executive agencies shall so far as practicable provide the Council information and reports relating to matters within the cognizance of the Council.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Upon request of the Chairman, the heads of Federal agencies shall, so far as practicable, provide the Council with information and reports relating to the scientific and technological activities of the respective agencies.
shared_material.explanation: Nearly identical information-and-reports clause, with the subject matter adapted from science and technology generally to radiation.
